w_name_ring: Ring of Death (close your tail loop)
modal_win_sub: You became the mind of the Macro-Leviathan — itself just a molecule inside EuroCorp-3. Every new run is a new universe.
biolab_sub: Permanent mutations persisted between runs. Biolab points are earned for survival and swarm kills.
codex_sub: Catalog of swarm organisms, DNA strains, and Great Hybrids in EuroCorp-3 reactor.
codex_unknown_lore: Biological specimen not yet cataloged. Encounter or evolve it in combat.
help_b1_p: Your tail is your body, biomass, and primary melee weapon. Movement burns segments; DNA orbs restore length. If your tail bottoms out while idle, starvation drains HP.
help_b2_p: Loop your tail path around enemies. The closed polygon collapses instantly, crushing everything inside (including Spore Cocoons). Longer tail = higher ring damage.
help_b3_p: Shift or Right-Click — burst smoothly through enemies with brief invulnerability and a dense spore trail.
help_b4_p: Space — drop a toxin beacon at cursor. Swarm scatters in panic and hostile strain burns away. 15s cooldown. 6 weapon types including mandibles and cysts.
help_d1_p: Vermis (whip & tail capacity), Chimera (plasma & blasts), Mycelium (spores & mind-control), Symbiont (magnet & speed).
help_d2_p: Reach DNA Level 3 in two branches to unlock fusion cards: Plasma Leviathan, Ouroboros Parasite, Phase Serpent, Spore Reactor, Ion Colossus, Psi-Web.
help_d3_p: Fill the biomass bar to 100% and slay the Scale Titan. The world expands, palettes shift, and whip damage permanently rises by +35%.
help_d4_p: Pathologies (crimson border) grant huge power with harsh drawbacks. Proto-Organelles add autonomous defense systems.
help_w1_p: Your own strain boosts speed (+25%) and regenerates tail. Hostile strain melts tail 1.8x faster. Each Scale shifts the biome substrate palette.
help_w2_p: Capture nodes with strain density (7 at start, +4 per scale): Generator (+HP / speeds foes), Amplifier (freezes tail melt / -20% dmg), Magnet (range / orb theft), Mutagen (±1 card), Incubator (+XP / spawns). 2+ owned nodes form a healing neural web.
help_w3_p: Corner Petri dish tracks swarms, elites, Wardens, Titans, bio-nodes, and anomalies: Acid Tide, Spore Cocoon, and Mitosis Bloom.
help_w4_p: Rapid DNA orb pickups build Symbiotic Resonance up to x3.0 XP and biomass. Biolab points and Codex bonuses persist across runs.
settings_flashes_hint: Softens or disables damage light pulses
settings_parallax_hint: Out-of-focus bokeh cells and floating plankton
settings_quality_hint: Particle swarm density and bloom post-processing
webgpu_required_desc: Simulating 120,000 Physarum slime mold agents requires WebGPU Compute Shaders.
webgpu_required_hint: Recommended: Chromium / Chrome 113+, Edge 113+, or Firefox with dom.webgpu.enabled enabled.
